item.title: Flutter: Classes Versus Functions for Widget Creation Performance and Reusability
item.description:
“Flutter: Classes Versus Functions for Widget Creation Performance and Reusability”

While functions offer syntactic brevity, Flutter’s architecture strongly favors classes for creating reusable widget trees. Why does the framework distinguish between these two approaches, and what are the tangible implications for performance, debugging, and state management?
